description: Call this when the user asks which coins are crowded or over-leveraged, or asks for the pressure/derivatives-stress score of specific coins. For a quick top-10 ranking of the highest-stress coins right now, use get_top_movers instead. Each symbol gets a 0-100 composite score built from funding rate, 1h/4h/24h open interest deltas and basis, with a LONG/SHORT/NEUTRAL direction and a plain-language regime label.

limit.description: Optional. Max rows to return when no symbol filter is set (default 20, sorted by score).

symbol.description: Optional. Return only this symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT or BTC.

name: get_pressure_scores
title: Derivatives pressure scores (funding + OI + basis composite)
